announcements.headline: Update on the Phalaborwa Rare Earths Project DFS
announcements.insight: The DFS completion de-risks the Phalaborwa project's path to production, addressing critical ESG hurdles regarding tailings management that have historically stalled UK-listed rare earth developers. This milestone is pivotal for securing offtake agreements and financing in a sector where geopolitical supply chain diversification is currently driving valuation premiums.
